reason: Reject empty-lineage and cyclic supersession graphs before retention selection.
changes: Supersession validation follows the complete chain to one active terminal release instead of checking one hop.
Every node must resolve uniquely, carry a nonempty matching skill, be complete and protected, and use an adopted/restricted decision with the fixed grace policy.
Each link must have a paired successor identity and timestamp.
Repeated identities reject self-links and cycles; missing and ambiguous nodes reject dangling chains.
Valid acyclic same-skill chains continue to authorize grace-based expiry.
